in_marathi.name: Kanthi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Compassion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kanthi is the name of a goddess who embodies love, compassion, and grace. She is believed to protect her devotees from harm and bestows them with happiness and prosperity. Kanthi is also known as the Goddess of Marriage and is often invoked for finding a loving partner.
